chunks: From him, from Abd al-Rahman, from Ibn Abi Hamza, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The Qaim (peace be upon him) will demolish the Sacred Mosque until he restores it to its foundation, and the Prophet's Mosque (peace be upon him and his family) to its foundation, and he will return the House to its place and establish it upon its foundation, and he will cut off the hands of the thieves of Bani Shaybah and hang them on the Kaaba.

key_terms.بَنِي شَيۡبَةَ: Bani Shaybah (a tribe known for guarding the Kaaba)
key_terms.ٱلۡقَآئِمُ: The Qaim (The Riser), a title for the Twelfth Imam

ai.seo_question: What will the Qaim do to the Kaaba and the mosques according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba*, this hadith highlights the Qaim’s role in restoring the primordial sanctity of Islam’s holiest sites by rebuilding the Kaaba and the Prophet’s Mosque to their original foundations. It also notes the specific retribution against the Bani Shaybah tribe for their historical theft of the Kaaba’s treasures, symbolizing the purification of divine spaces from corruption. This act underscores the Imam’s authority in rectifying both physical structures and spiritual integrity during the era of reappearance.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 492 - It is narrated from Fadhl from Abdur Rahman from Ibn Abu Hamza from Abu Basir from Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s) that he said: “

Qaim (a.s) would demolish Masjidul Haraam till it returns to its ancient form and he would also return the Prophet’s Masjid (Masjidun Nabawi) to its original construction and the Holy Kaaba to its location and raise it on its original foundations. He will cut off the hand of Bani Shaibah and hang it on the Kaaba as they are the thieves of the Kaaba.”
